verdict.rationale: A robotics platform with on-robot deployment (Isaac ROS on Jetson) could plausibly ship robot-to-cloud data logging and sync, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows adjacent features: simulated sensor capture in Isaac Sim, and teleoperated demonstration capture converted for GR00T post-training. Nothing documents on-robot telemetry recording, cloud upload or sync, or bandwidth-aware sync policies, so these do not credit the story.
